cases.name: put_get_roundtrip
cases.description: A stored record reads back with content_sha256 filled in.

cases.name: artifact_limit
cases.description: Exactly 64 artifacts are admitted; 65 are invalid.

cases.name: idempotent_retry
cases.description: Byte-identical retries, in any artifact order, succeed without change.

cases.name: conflicting_rewrite
cases.description: A different record under the same Capsule ID is a conflict and changes nothing.

cases.name: rejected_records
cases.description: Each record failing admission is rejected with its code and nothing is stored.

cases.name: unknown_ids
cases.description: Well-formed unknown IDs are not_found.

cases.name: malformed_ids
cases.description: Malformed IDs are invalid before any lookup.

cases.name: purge_lifecycle
cases.description: Purge tombstones present originals idempotently; purged originals cannot be rewritten.

cases.name: purge_is_per_record
cases.description: Purging one record leaves the others intact.

cases.name: never_retained_survives_purge
cases.description: Purge leaves never_retained artifacts unchanged.

cases.name: empty_inventory
cases.description: A record with no artifacts stores, purges and retries.

cases.name: zero_length_original
cases.description: Zero-length content is present, distinct from absent content.

cases.name: effect_bindings
cases.description: Effect request and response preimages verify against their digests.

cases.name: key_rotation
cases.description: A store trusting several keys admits records from each.

cases.name: bare_record
cases.description: A record without originals stores, retries idempotently and conflicts with another envelope.

cases.name: bare_rejections
cases.description: Records without originals that fail admission are rejected and nothing is stored.

cases.name: padding_record
cases.description: A padding record is admitted by its closed shape, reads back and retries idempotently.

cases.name: padding_rejections
cases.description: Padding records failing their shape, id, envelope or attachment rules are rejected.

cases.name: padding_unbound_original
cases.description: A padding record may keep an unbound attachment, which purges like any original, but no bound one.

cases.name: durable_reopen
cases.description: Records, purges and conflicts persist across reopening.

cases.name: untrusted_on_read
cases.description: Reads fail closed when the signer is no longer trusted; purge still erases.

cases.name: bare_untrusted_on_read
cases.description: Reads of a record without originals fail closed when its signer is no longer trusted.

cases.name: namespace_isolation
cases.description: Namespaces sharing storage do not see each other's records.
